finalText: No test suite in the repo to run. The migration is done: all 12 non-vendor files (36 call sites) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used in `pageviewService.js`. The only remaining `db.query` call is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which I left alone — it's explicitly marked as a vendored file that's replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits there would be silently lost. That one will need to wait for the vendor library itself to drop the old form (or for a wrapper outside the vendor dir).
